text: Which genes enhanced in macrophages (single-cell) stain moderately or strongly in lung macrophages?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Macrophages / Cell type enhanced AND Tissue expression (IHC): Lung / macrophages / Medium, High
understanding: The user is querying for genes that have enhanced RNA expression in macrophages based on single-cell RNA sequencing data and show moderate or strong (medium or high) antibody staining by immunohistochemistry (IHC) in macrophages within lung tissue.
